name: The Manor Courtyard and Putting Garden
description: The middle of the grounds at The Manor is a putting garden, with a gazebo and walks through the beds. Closer to the building, those walks open onto a courtyard and a waterfall. After dark, the lights pick up the paths and the stone.
metaDescription: Putting garden, gazebo, courtyard, and waterfall at The Manor in Florence, with lighting along the walks.
story: We built a putting garden in the middle of the grounds, with two greens, a gazebo, and walks through the beds. Closer to the building, the walks lead out to a patio and a waterfall wall. The paths and the stone are lit after dark. The greens and the patio are graded so water runs off them instead of pooling.
